Normal (2003 film) | Normal is a 2003 drama film produced by HBO Films, which became an official selection at the 2003 Sundance Film Festival.  Jane Anderson, the film's writer and director, adapted her own play, "Looking for Normal".  The film is about the gender transition of Ruth Applewood, a transgender woman who had been living as a man for 25 years of marriage.  A Midwestern factory worker, Applewood (then going by "Roy") stuns her wife of 25 years by saying she wishes to undergo sex reassignment surgery and transition to living as a woman.  The film was praised by most critics, and was nominated for numerous awards.
